prompt.text:
Implement `pub fn heaviest_route(node_count: usize, root: usize, edges: &[(usize, usize, i64)]) -> Option<i64>` using only the standard library. Each tuple is a directed `(parent, child, weight)` edge. Return the greatest sum along a path from `root` to a leaf. A one-node tree has result `Some(0)`, and negative weights remain negative rather than being replaced by zero. Return `None` unless the input is exactly one rooted tree: `node_count` is nonzero, `root` is in range, there are exactly `node_count - 1` edges, endpoints are in range, no self-edge exists, the root has no parent, every other node has exactly one parent, and every node is reachable from the root. Return `None` if any path sum overflows `i64`. Do not mutate `edges`. Provide complete `solution.rs` without `main`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
